name: Lake Plaza Shopping Center
summary: Lake Plaza Shopping Center is a fully renovated 166,186 square foot community center in Mahopac, NY, featuring a new Stop & Shop anchor and diverse tenant mix including Ocean State Job Lot, Dollar Tree, healthcare services, and local dining options. The modernized center offers 716 parking spaces and serves as a convenient one-stop destination for everyday shopping and services in Putnam County.
demographics: Lake Plaza Shopping Center serves the Mahopac community in Putnam County, New York, attracting primarily middle-income families and suburban households. The trade area draws from surrounding residential neighborhoods with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees seeking convenient access to everyday necessities and services. Shoppers typically visit for grocery shopping at Stop & Shop, value-oriented retail at Ocean State Job Lot and Dollar Tree, and essential services including banking, dining, and personal care, reflecting a practical, needs-based shopping pattern common to suburban community centers.
description: Lake Plaza Shopping Center in Mahopac, New York has undergone a comprehensive full-scale redevelopment and expansion that transformed this Putnam County retail destination into a modern 166,186 square foot community shopping hub. The ambitious renovation added 30,000 square feet of retail space and included the construction of a new 54,000 square foot Stop & Shop supermarket, serving as the center's primary anchor. The improvements extended beyond new construction to include a completely refreshed façade, updated pylon signage, additional parking spaces bringing the total to 716 spots, complete parking lot resurfacing, energy-efficient LED lighting throughout, and enhanced landscaping that creates an inviting shopping environment. Today's tenant mix offers a diverse array of shopping and services, anchored by Ocean State Job Lot and complemented by national retailers like Dollar Tree and NAPA Auto Parts, alongside essential services including KeyBank, Nuvance Health, Pulse MD Urgent Care, and local favorites such as D'Berto's Pizzeria, Grand Buffet restaurant, a nail salon, liquor store, and specialty shops. Managed by Heidenberg Properties, Lake Plaza Shopping Center represents a successful revitalization that continues to serve as a vital retail and service hub for the Mahopac community along Route 6.
